title: Fluxo
subtitle: Streamlining Dispatch Operations
overview: Fluxo is a logistics and dispatch management platform designed for modern dispatch companies and fleet managers. By replacing fragmented communication channels — phone calls, chat apps, and spreadsheets — with a unified centralized dashboard, Fluxo simplifies rider tracking, order creation, and delivery operations.
problem: Dispatch and logistics companies face severe operational friction as they scale. Orders are scattered across phone calls, instant messages, and manual spreadsheets, leading to lost data and missed deliveries. Managers spend hours manually calling riders for location updates — "Where is the rider?" "Has the order been picked up?" — and rapid growth leads to operational breakdown from a lack of central oversight, leaving owners managing chaos instead of focusing on strategic growth.
solution: Fluxo provides a single centralized platform — one dashboard — to control every stage of the dispatch workflow: orders are created and organized, tracked with real-time rider locations, through to seamless pickup and delivery. Centralized order management, live rider tracking, and end-to-end operational control replace the multi-tool chaos and give owners back their time.

features.title: Centralized Order Management
features.description: Easily create, organize, and monitor delivery orders without losing details in chats or spreadsheets.

features.title: Rider Management & Live Tracking
features.description: Gain real-time visibility into rider locations on map interfaces to eliminate status-update calls.

features.title: End-to-End Operational Control
features.description: Assign orders directly to riders and monitor status transitions from pickup to final delivery.

results.description: Consolidates orders, riders, and deliveries, removing multi-tool complexity and data silos.
Eliminates manual phone check-ins and messaging, freeing operational time for managers and drivers.
Designed for growing dispatch operations, preventing growth from turning into operational chaos.
